text:
elaine: Heads up 1 quick design review for API keys page. Problem: admins sometimes bulk-revoke keys and then need to recover. Proposal: move single-key Revoke into kebab, keep Rotate visible; for bulk-revoke show an explicit warning with checklist, require typed confirmation for >5 keys. Soft-undo window: default 30s, org-configurable up to 60s. Also copy + a11y asks for revoke dialog and clipboard toasts. Link to mock: https://img.redwood/mock/bulk-revoke.png

pablo: Agree on typed confirm for big batches. For small sets (<5) keep modal + undo toast. For bulk action, include an audit link in the modal: "View affected services" so admins can double-check.

sasha: UX nits: wording for bulk modal should be short and action-oriented: "You're about to disable 12 keys. This will stop apps using them. Type DISABLE to confirm." Put the undo hint in the toast only, not inside the modal, to avoid clutter. Also ensure keyboard focus lands on the confirm input when modal opens.

kevin: A11y: revoke modal must be role="alertdialog", trap focus, and use aria-describedby for the long warning copy. For typed confirm input, associate label and use aria-required. Toasts: aria-live="polite" for success, aria-live="assertive" for failure. For clipboard reveal, use concise visible toast like "Secret copied" and a hidden assertive SR message only on failure.

ops-kate: Ops constraints: backend toggles keys to disabled state immediately. The undo window is a front-end/local metadata grace period: we can accept it at 30s default; longer windows need a follow-up on monitoring changes. Also recommend surfacing whether a key is in-flight (last used) next to each key so admins avoid revoking active ones.

aria-bot: accessibility-check: recommend aria-atomic="true" on toast container, ensure high-contrast warning styles, and verify focus order when modal closes (return focus to kebab button).

elaine: decisions: 1) Single-key Revoke -> kebab, Rotate visible. 2) Bulk revoke: typed confirm if >=5 keys, show audit link. 3) Default undo window 30s, admin can extend to 60s. 4) Copy/edit: change toast copy to "Secret copied"; modal copy uses active phrasing "This key will stop working for your apps." I'll update mocks and spec and post in #design when ready. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
